_status: Frozen for the submission. Physics-based values, checked on external matches only (cleaned degraded copies vs their originals); never chosen on the provided game.

ball._max_speed_mps: Hard shots ~30-35 m/s; margin because an airborne ball projected to the ground can appear faster. from real IDSSE speeds.
ball._min_segment_frames: A run of ball observations shorter than this, bounded by an impossible jump, is a false detection.
ball._max_gap_frames: Longest gap that may be interpolated (12 frames = 0.48 s at 25 fps).
ball._max_endpoint_velocity_change_mps: Rulebook 1.7 'compatible movement': skip a gap if the ball's velocity before and after differs by more than this.
ball._block_if_nearest_team_changes: Rulebook 1.7 'no evidence of intervening interactions': skip a gap if the nearest player within interaction_radius_m belongs to different teams at its two ends.

players._max_speed_mps: Fastest recorded human sprint peaks ~12.4 m/s.
players._speed_window_frames: speed_derived_ms uses a centred difference over +/- this many frames (2 -> 0.16 s at 25 fps) to smooth tracking jitter. Values above max_speed_mps become NaN.
players._min_jump_m: A step must also be longer than this to count as a jump. Frame-to-frame jitter on a fast sprint gave 13-20 m/s one-frame steps on Metrica Game 3 (~0.5-0.8 m); identity jumps are metres.

duplicates._note: Same-team tracks this close for this long are merged, but only in frames where that team has more than max_players_per_team tracks (a 12th track is the duplicate). Without the gate, ~99% of merges on clean IDSSE were genuine teammates at dead balls (walls, celebrations). Check genuine_points_merged_away in the evaluation.
